data.body: Phase 4 RP02 clarification (decision still pending): history and current tickets show this is residual representation cleanup, not a request to repeat the closed RP-03 coordinator redesign. RP-03 (`unfearful-dejected-verdin`) introduced immutable `Observation`/`TicketPlan` and coordinator/retry/fuse ownership while intentionally preserving mutation bytes/shapes. The current 24-value outbound builder seam and renewed cap pressure sit beneath/around that architecture. Existing chain `financial-stoneware-brant` already owns the work: `scummy-ultrashort-tuatara` contract -> `wormlike-buried-grunion` headroom -> `earthborn-statuelike-boutu` typed parity -> `single-vast-roan` cutover/deletion. Recommended RP02 refinement: reuse Observation/TicketPlan; do not create a second generic pass/ticket context or independently split legacy dispatch; map the finding to that existing chain and reassess residual reconcile*.py pressure after deletion.
